preauthorized.reason: #3000 Phase-1b: buildIrClassShapes re-derives class-field IR types from the raw ts.Type of a field's declaration node (PropertyDeclaration / ctor this.x= LHS). The surrounding function already reads ctor/method param + return types the same way; the ctx.oracle abstraction exposes only TypeFact, not the raw ts.Type that tsTypeToClassPositionIr requires (t.flags & StringLike, t.getSymbol(), objectIrTypeFromTsType). Consistent with the existing direct-checker code in this function.
#3000 Phase-1b: the single ctx.checker.getTypeAtLocation call above (buildIrClassShapes field-type derivation).

#3057: sourceHasDynamicTaConstruct pre-scan gates the dynamic-`new ctorVar(buffer)` element-codec flag on the first arg's NOMINAL buffer type (getSymbol().name === 'ArrayBuffer'/'SharedArrayBuffer'/'DataView'), mirroring the runtime dynamic-construct gate in new-super.ts. ctx.oracle's TypeFact union exposes only jsTag/shape, not the nominal symbol name this precision gate requires (dropping it over-triggers on new Map(x)/new Set(x)/... and breaks byte-inertness). Uses a local `checker` param (not ctx.checker), so only getTypeAtLocation grows.

#2173 slice-2b: isGenericIterableDelegate needs ts.Type property membership to gate a yield* subject as a genuine iterable (a [Symbol.iterator] member — spec GetIterator). ctx.oracle's TypeFact union has no iterability/property-membership query and models iterables inconsistently (ArrayIterator as class, custom {[Symbol.iterator]} as builtin 'Iterable', Map/Set/generator/String each differently), so an oracle-based gate would be fragile and incomplete. Mirrors the existing direct-checker use in nativeGeneratorDelegationName in this same file.
#2173 slice-2b: the getTypeAtLocation + getPropertiesOfType pair in isGenericIterableDelegate (see the getTypeAtLocation entry above) — both match the ctx.checker counter.

#3064: the standalone escape/unescape routing block ToString-coerces its argument via emitToString(ctx, fctx, arg0Type, arg0TsType, 'string') — exactly like the adjacent String()/parseInt/URI blocks. emitToString requires a raw ts.Type; the ctx.oracle abstraction exposes only TypeFact, not the raw ts.Type, so arg0TsType must come from ctx.checker.getTypeAtLocation (consistent with the #3000 precedent and the surrounding direct-checker code in this dispatcher).
#3064: the single ctx.checker.getTypeAtLocation call above (standalone escape/unescape argument ToString).

#3051 slice-3: hasAccessorInitializer resolves a bare identifier to its var declaration to detect `var x = { get p(){} }` then bare `x` (accessor-only exec-result marshalling). Needs ctx.checker.getSymbolAtLocation(e) -> valueDeclaration; ctx.oracle exposes only TypeFact, not symbol/declaration resolution. Migrate when the oracle grows an identifier->declaration resolver.
